edits.anchor: Food is a 30-minute grocery run round-trip: Food Lion isn't fancy, but the staff is friendly and it's got everything you need
edits.before: Food is a 30-minute grocery run round-trip: Food Lion isn't fancy, but the staff is friendly and it's got everything you need. On the way in it's worth a detour to Kellum Farms, one of the Northern Neck's best local farm stands. Their Irvington location carries local produce, oysters, and shrimp — call ahead to confirm what they've got, since it shifts with the season.
edits.after: Our standing advice: order groceries for delivery before you leave home, timed to arrive around when you do. No detour, no errand — you pull up and the bags are waiting. Separately, build a little time for Kellum Farms — it's a proper small excursion, not on the way to anything, but worth it for the local produce, oysters, and shrimp. Call ahead to see what they've got; it shifts with the season.
edits.note: Removed the Food Lion caveat framing entirely ('isn't fancy, but...'). Replaced the whole grocery paragraph with Will's two pro-tips: (1) order delivery timed to your arrival so no detour is needed; (2) Kellum Farms as a separate, deliberate small excursion — reframed from 'on the way in' (it isn't) to a thing worth building time around. Kellum internal link via withBase('/area') preserved.
